title: Conference room laptop has no network
scenario: Ticket #4502 — The laptop in the conference room (CONF-LT-01) shows a network icon with a warning and cannot reach anything, not even the shared drive. It was plugged in during this morning's network maintenance, which has since finished. Site standard: every workstation gets its address automatically from the office DHCP server.
tasks: Look at the address the laptop is using and decide what it tells you.
Get the laptop a proper address without breaking the site standard.
Prove the laptop can reach the internet before you close the ticket.
hints: Run ipconfig and read the IPv4 line carefully. Is that an address the office would hand out?
An address starting with 169.254 is one the computer gave itself because it never heard back from a DHCP server.
Maintenance is over, so the DHCP server is available again. The laptop just needs to ask again.
ipconfig has switches for giving up and requesting an address. Type ipconfig /? or try ipconfig /renew.
After the renew, ping an outside address such as 8.8.8.8 to prove it worked.

checks.label: Checked the laptop's address before changing anything
checks.pass: You ran ipconfig first and saw the 169.254 address.
checks.fail: You made a change before running ipconfig. The 169.254 address is the clue that explains this whole ticket.

checks.label: The laptop can reach the internet
checks.pass: The laptop has a working address and can reach outside sites.
checks.fail: The laptop still cannot reach the internet. A 169.254 (APIPA) address means no DHCP lease; it needs to request one with ipconfig /renew.

checks.label: The adapter still follows the site standard (DHCP)
checks.pass: You left the adapter on DHCP, as the site standard requires.
checks.fail: You gave the laptop a manual address. It may work today, but it breaks the site standard and can cause an address conflict later.

checks.label: Verified the fix with a successful test to an outside address
checks.pass: After your last change you confirmed an outside address replies.
checks.fail: You did not run a successful ping to an outside address after your last change. A fix is not finished until you have verified it.
